measureRecords.whatItDoes: Authorizes Mableton to carry out community redevelopment, create tax allocation districts, issue tax allocation bonds and take on other obligations under Georgia’s Redevelopment Powers Law. Tax allocation districts use tax revenue attributable to rising property values within designated development areas for neighborhood improvements. The authority would cover the redevelopment powers allowed by that state law as it changes over time and would take effect immediately if more than half of the votes on the question are Yes.
measureRecords.yesMeans: Authorize the city to exercise the redevelopment powers described in the Act.
measureRecords.noMeans: Reject granting these redevelopment powers to the city.
